title: Morning Prayer to Start Your Day with God
text: Before we pray, let's first take a moment to listen to God's word and then we'll pray together. [Music] Heavenly Father, I thank you for waking me up this morning. I thank you for the breath in my lungs, the beating of my heart, and the opportunity to see a new day. Your word says in Lamentations 3:22-23, "Through the Lord's mercies, we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness. Lord, I receive your new mercies today with a grateful heart. I lift my voice in praise to you, oh Lord, for you are good and your mercy endures forever. I acknowledge that without you, I can do nothing. But with you, all things are possible. I commit my day into your hands, trusting that you will guide my steps, direct my decisions, and keep me from harm. Order my steps according to your word, and let no iniquity have dominion over me. Lord Jesus, I ask you to cleanse me of any sin I have committed in thought, word, or deed. And wash me in your precious blood. Let my heart be pure before you today. Fill me with the Holy Spirit and let your fruit, love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control overflow in my life. Clothe me in the full armor of God so that I may stand against every scheme of the enemy. I declare over my life that no weapon formed against me shall prosper and every tongue that rises against me in judgment is condemned in Jesus' name. Father, open doors for me that no man can shut. Grant me favor with the right people and protection from the wrong people. Give me discernment to know your will and the courage to walk in it. Let my words bring life to others. And let my actions bring glory to your name. I step into this day with faith, joy, and confidence knowing that you are with me. Thank you, Lord, for hearing my prayer and for answering according to your perfect will. I seal this prayer in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Help me to walk in humility, not thinking of myself more highly than I ought, but esteeming others above myself. Let my love be genuine, not shallow or self-s serving. Let my service be cheerful, not grudging. Let my words be seasoned with grace, bringing life and not harm. Let my reactions reflect patience and gentleness even when tested. When I grow weary, be my strength. When I feel discouraged, be my hope. When I am uncertain, be my anchor. When I am tempted, be my escape. When I am lonely, remind me of your presence. And when I succeed, keep me humble and quick to give you the glory. As the hours unfold, give me a spirit of prayer that does not fade after this moment, but lingers throughout the day. A heart that speaks with you in the quiet of my thoughts. A readiness to lift thanks and joy and to call on you in need. Teach me to abide in you so closely that your desires become my desires, your heart my heart, your ways my ways. For you have said, "I am the vine. You are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit. Apart from me, you can do nothing. John 15:5. Let that truth be my compass. And finally, Lord, I pray for a deeper hunger for you. Let me not be satisfied with a shallow faith or a passing knowledge of you. Draw me into the depths of your word, into the richness of communion with you in prayer, into the joy of obedience, into the peace of surrender. Let me know you more tomorrow than I do today and more today than I did yesterday. So here I am, Lord. Yours completely. Take my mind, my heart, my hands, my voice. Use me to bless, to serve, to speak truth, to bring comfort, to extend grace. Keep me close, keep me faithful. Keep me in step with your spirit. And at the close of this day, may I look back and see your fingerprints on every moment, knowing I walked not alone, but with you. I offer this prayer in the name of Jesus, my savior, my lord, my friend, my life. Amen. If this prayer has touched your heart, please type amen as a sign of faith and subscribe to our channel to stay connected as part of the grace enclave family. I pray that every blessing in this prayer is now upon you in the name of Jesus. And if you need a special prayer, feel free to let us know in the comment. We would be honored to pray for you. May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you always. [Music] [Music] Heat. Heat. [Music] Perfect. [Music] [Music]
